The '''Madyn Plains''' was a plain located on the [[Naboo/Legends|Nabooian]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. It was located between the [[Lake Octir Swamp]] and the [[Narmle Bog]].<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] piloted by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cal Handro]] that was transporting a new kind of [[Syren spice|spice]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] crashed in the plains.<ref name="SWG:MD">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other}}Quest: "Man Down!"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Madyn Plains are one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
